track_5_cross_dataset.description: Requires official un-leaked full VisA and BTAD external datasets. Evaluated within software boundary.

false_alarm_inspection.root_cause: High-frequency surface textures (rough leather grain, woven tiles) exceed raw Euclidean nearest-neighbor distances when calibrated on self-training memory bank.
false_alarm_inspection.mitigation_applied: Independent split-conformal calibration on held-out val_calibration samples + robust MAD reference scaling + top-k spatial pooling.

tiny_defects_inspection.root_cause: Defects occupying <0.1% of image area (micro-cracks, needle pinholes) are prone to attenuation in deep pooling layers.
tiny_defects_inspection.mitigation_applied: Multi-scale intermediate extraction (DINOv2 Block 4 fine detail skip concatenated with Block 8 contextual tokens) + Tversky asymmetric loss + dynamic defect stratification.
tiny_defects_inspection.tiny_defect_recall: Evaluated across defect size stratification in metrics.

ood_detection.detector: Mahalanobis distance with Ledoit-Wolf shrinkage covariance.
ood_detection.fail_closed_guarantee: Uncalibrated categories or distance > threshold strictly escalate to HUMAN_REVIEW / QUARANTINE.
